title: Band-9 Samples: Have the kinds of clothes you like changed in recent years? [Why/why not?]
content:
This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 12 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 4 Test 3 question:

“Have the kinds of clothes you like changed in recent years? [Why/why not?]”

Sample 1: Yes

Yes, my preferences for attire have indeed shifted in recent years, and the primary catalyst has been my growing awareness of environmental concerns. I used to be quite keen on fast fashion, always chasing after the latest trends. However, the more I learned about the harmful impact of such practices on our planet, the more I began to gravitate towards sustainable clothing. Now, I tend to opt for pieces that are ethically made and built to last, rather than those that are simply in vogue.

Sample 2: Yes

My taste in apparel has definitely evolved as I’ve gained financial independence. As a student, I used to gravitate towards budget-friendly options, often compromising on quality or style. Now that I’ve started earning, I can afford to invest in higher-quality pieces that align better with my personal style, which tends to lean towards more sophisticated and well-crafted attire.

Sample 3: Yes

Yes, my clothing preference has shifted, mainly due to my professional needs. Earlier, I was more inclined towards casual attire as I was a student. Now, working in the corporate sector, I’ve developed a taste for formal wear. I’ve noticed that a well-tailored suit can project a sense of professionalism and confidence.

Sample 4: Yes

Social media has played a huge part in changing my clothing preferences. I was never into fashion, but seeing influencers and fashion bloggers showcasing their style has piqued my interest. I’ve started experimenting with different styles and trends that I see online, and it’s made me more adventurous with my clothing choices.

Sample 5: No

Honestly, the types of garments I wear have remained the same for quite some time. I’ve always prioritized comfort over everything else. So, whether it’s a decade ago or now, you’ll mostly find me in casual attire – jeans, t-shirts, and sneakers. They’re practical, easy-going, and allow me to move around freely.

Sample 6: No

No, I can’t say my clothing tastes have shifted recently. I’ve always been a practical person, so I tend to choose clothes that serve a function. For example, I prefer wearing clothes with plenty of pockets or those that are easy to layer. The fashion industry changes rapidly, but the practicality that I seek in my clothes has been a consistent factor in my wardrobe decisions.

Sample 7: No

Frankly, there hasn’t been any significant change in my clothing preferences. My choices are driven more by financial prudence than by changing fashion trends. I tend to prefer clothes that offer good value for money and aren’t necessarily from the latest collections. This approach has helped me maintain a balanced wardrobe without straining my finances.

Sample 8: No

To be honest, my fashion taste has been pretty stable over time. I am a fitness enthusiast and that reflects in my attire. I’m most comfortable in athleisure or gym wear, and that hasn’t changed despite the fluctuations in fashion trends. The functionality and comfort they offer while working out make it an easy choice for me.

Sample 9: It Depends

Well, it’s a bit of a mixed bag for me. You see, my professional life has greatly swayed my clothing preferences. Due to my job as a corporate lawyer, I have found myself leaning towards more formal attire. This is in stark contrast to my university days when I was all about casual wear. So, in that regard, yes, the kinds of clothes I prefer have undergone a change. However, when I’m off the clock, I still enjoy slipping into my comfortable jeans and t-shirts. Hence, it’s not a complete transition, but rather a balance of both worlds.

Sample 10: It Depends

You know, it’s dependent on the context. My aesthetic preferences haven’t undergone a drastic change, but I’ve become more conscious about the environmental impact of my clothing choices. This has led me to opt for sustainable brands and second-hand pieces more often, even if it means compromising on the latest trends occasionally.
